title: Footsteps Approaching
blurb: Somebody is coming, and they are not hurrying. Five seconds of measured footfalls getting steadily closer is the oldest suspense device in film sound and still the most reliable, because you know exactly what is happening and you cannot see it, so your imagination does the expensive work. Horror shorts, YouTube skits and Discord jumpscares all use the clip the same way: play it, say nothing, wait. It is also genuinely handy for creators who need clean, unfussy foley for a scene where a character walks into frame.
origin: Footsteps approaching, a foley suspense staple.
